evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology Beijing Institute of Precision Mechatronics Control Equipment”, a research institute of the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology (CALT), which CASC lists among its eight research academies. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft. The US Commerce Department listed it in March 2025 for acquiring or attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization, citing ties to activities including hypersonic weapons development.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
